Name: Broken Buildings Start
Author: LemonsOnFire
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Allows you to start with broken versions of the Buildings that you will most likely use on a given Farm Map.
As of Version 1.3.0 it has default locations for all vanilla farms and some modded farms but can be configured to place buildings on any farm (Even Custom Farm Maps).[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Standard Mod Installation[/color][/size]

Intended for new saves but can be used on existing saves by using the Dangerous option in the config.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[spoiler]General
[list]
[*]Enable/Disable each building type (Default: Enabled) - effects both pre-planned and custom coordinates[/*]
[/list]Custom Coordinates
[list]
[*]Use custom Coordinates (Default: false) - uses the coordinates lower in the config instead of the pre-planned locations from the other data files[/*]
[*]Building x/y coordinates - used when "Use Custom Coordinates" is true. used to set the Farm coordinates to place the buildings.[/*]
[/list]Dangerous
[list]
[*]Allow Spawn mid-save  (Default: false) - this will allow spawning the buildings in after the end of day one. can be enabled any time. once placed can not be undone without visiting Robin/Wizard to remove the buildings.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
There is an issue with Buildings Included where it is always adding a cabin to the farm. I have submitted a Pull Request to their GitHub to fix this. If I do not hear any thing for a while I will upload an Unofficial Patch to resolve this.
It looks like version 1.1.1 of Buildings Included does not have the always add cabin bug but if another mod uses that framework to add a Cabin there could be issues.

Since this matches farms by type, If used with maps that overwrite an existing map there could be placement issues but these can be resolved by using the custom settings in the config.
